problem_text:
A hospital has 9 patients who must each undergo 9 medical procedures. Each patient's treatment plan consists of a specific sequence of procedures represented as (Treatment Room, Duration) pairs, where each pair specifies the room where the procedure must be performed and the time it takes. The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the procedures must be completed.

Patient treatment plans:
* Patient 1 requires: (Room 2, 1) → (Room 4, 6) → (Room 9, 4) → (Room 3, 7) → (Room 5, 10) → (Room 8, 2) → (Room 1, 7) → (Room 6, 4) → (Room 7, 6)
* Patient 2 requires: (Room 2, 7) → (Room 9, 7) → (Room 6, 4) → (Room 8, 4) → (Room 3, 1) → (Room 7, 9) → (Room 5, 5) → (Room 1, 7) → (Room 4, 4)
* Patient 3 requires: (Room 9, 10) → (Room 2, 4) → (Room 7, 10) → (Room 5, 1) → (Room 3, 10) → (Room 6, 2) → (Room 8, 5) → (Room 1, 7) → (Room 4, 2)
* Patient 4 requires: (Room 1, 10) → (Room 2, 2) → (Room 3, 2) → (Room 7, 7) → (Room 9, 8) → (Room 6, 3) → (Room 5, 6) → (Room 4, 4) → (Room 8, 3)
* Patient 5 requires: (Room 4, 7) → (Room 3, 4) → (Room 1, 4) → (Room 6, 10) → (Room 5, 2) → (Room 7, 6) → (Room 2, 3) → (Room 8, 5) → (Room 9, 2)
* Patient 6 requires: (Room 8, 3) → (Room 9, 10) → (Room 2, 4) → (Room 6, 10) → (Room 4, 7) → (Room 3, 6) → (Room 7, 7) → (Room 1, 5) → (Room 5, 7)
* Patient 7 requires: (Room 3, 10) → (Room 9, 5) → (Room 6, 1) → (Room 5, 5) → (Room 7, 8) → (Room 4, 4) → (Room 1, 7) → (Room 8, 4) → (Room 2, 5)
* Patient 8 requires: (Room 6, 1) → (Room 1, 7) → (Room 3, 10) → (Room 8, 5) → (Room 4, 8) → (Room 9, 6) → (Room 7, 1) → (Room 5, 9) → (Room 2, 7)
* Patient 9 requires: (Room 2, 2) → (Room 7, 10) → (Room 3, 1) → (Room 6, 9) → (Room 1, 2) → (Room 8, 10) → (Room 5, 9) → (Room 4, 1) → (Room 9, 4)

Each procedure must be performed continuously without interruption once it begins, and each treatment room can only accommodate one patient at a time. The objective is to schedule all procedures across the treatment rooms so that the total completion time for all patients is minimized.
